defects.title: "Missing input" was no longer detected for the documented example
defects.detail: DEMO.md and examples.js say the transcript prompt scores a high-severity "references input that is not clearly attached" with Context 24/100. It scored a low "pasted input is not delimited", because the heuristic counted the rest of the instruction sentence after "transcript below" as pasted input.
defects.fix: server/analyze.js: pasted input starts on a new line or after a colon; the rest of the referencing sentence is instruction.

defects.title: An upstream error could carry the API key to the browser
defects.detail: A provider whose error body echoes the key had that body forwarded verbatim, in the error response and inside a successful reply's retry warning. The README promises keys never leave the server.
defects.fix: server/providers.js redact() blanks every configured key at the source; server/index.js applies it again in the error handler.

defects.title: A saved library example returned verbatim was accepted as the rewrite
defects.detail: A parroted example shares enough vocabulary with the prompt to clear the Balanced retention floor, and the leak detector only recognised the <examples> wrapper, so another prompt's text was handed back as the user's rewrite.
defects.fix: server/metaprompt.js validateRewrite() receives the examples and treats an exact match with any example as a leak; after two attempts the user gets their original back with a warning naming the library toggle.

defects.title: API errors did not all have the same shape
defects.detail: An unknown /api path returned Express's HTML "Cannot GET" page while every other failure is JSON, and the JSON envelope dropped code/provider when undefined.
defects.fix: server/index.js: JSON 404 for any unmatched /api path through the normal error handler; code and provider always present (null when unknown).

defects.title: Tab count badges were below AA contrast
defects.detail: The count badge on an unselected tab ("Issues 11") used --text-faint on --panel-3: 4.18:1, below the 4.5:1 the token's own comment promises. Found by measuring every rendered text node in Chromium, not by reading the tokens.

defects.title: The results pane header pushed Save off the page at 1024px wide
defects.detail: Tabs, the history control and Copy/Apply/Save sit in a non-wrapping flex row; at 1024px the Save button ended at 1055px and the whole page scrolled horizontally.

observations: Ollama shows as configured whenever its default URL is set, even with nothing listening (G1 is stricter than the code; a decision for the three amigos).
Demo numbers in DEMO.md / examples.js are stale after the A8 fix (transcript example is now 66/C, not 62/D); the definition of done says DEMO.md is regenerated when the linter changes.
server/data/library.json.tmp-27896 is a crashed-write leftover that is committed to git; it should be removed with git rm.
H8: "download in progress" and "cancel settling" sub-cases need a model file and stay nightly; the other three states are asserted in the browser.
